node.title: XR deficient-window payment: outside-forced-set pairs cost at most n-|G|
node.statement: For the left syzygy space K_d of a deficient stacked high-window matrix, let G_d be the evaluation points at which both components of every syzygy vanish. Vandermonde inversion makes every syzygy a pointwise rational error-direction law for every maximal depth-d pair. At q>n there is a syzygy whose common H-root set is exactly G_d, all syzygies are divisible by its locator, dim K_d<=2(d-|G_d|), and rank J_d>=2|G_d|. Partition N_d into N_d^out, whose pairs have a selected off-core point outside G_d, and N_d^G, whose complete selected off-core geometry lies in G_d. High-depth first-match ray injectivity gives N_d^out<=n-|G_d| unconditionally, while N_d^G>0 implies |G_d|>=2(h-d). Hence only the G_d-local deficient family remains unpaid.
